'''Silverwing Grove''' is located in south-central [[Ashenvale]], southwest of [[Silverwing Outpost]] and west of [[Fallen Sky Lake]]. It is the location of the entrance to the [[Warsong Gulch]] battlegrounds, and holds several [[pvp]]-aligned [[npc]]s, including an [[Alliance Brigadier General]], a pair of [[vendor]]s, and another pvp [[quest giver]] named {{RaceIcon|NightElf|Female|Small}}{{NPC|Alliance|Sentinel Farsong|Silverwing Sentinels}}.
